notes: A pathwise trace has no exact outcome-probability theorem by itself.
rules: Every record and link keeps its recorded state; most are PROPOSED (AI-drafted, unreviewed). Say so when you use them.

Cite the paper and the PDF page in the record's sources, and check the paper before relying on a claim.
Counts are indexed records, not distinct ideas or papers. Absence of a record is a gap in the atlas, not evidence that nothing exists.
state_meaning: Tied to an exact source location; not reviewed for meaning.
text: The saved traces record possible draw-tape paths or reproducible pseudorandom examples, with stage order and query counts. They come from a two-step pathwise interpreter for pinned sampled strategies, and neither kind provides a probability theorem; the scripted trace shown is marked as a pathwise trace only, from which no formal probability bound follows.
title: Scripted and seeded execution traces
